info.title: Sqloom
info.description: CLI for replaying API requests, correlating SQL with Query Store, and generating tuning advice.

commands.name: advise
commands.description: Generates evidence-backed tuning advice and SQL proposals.

options.name: --replay-artifact-dir
options.description: Replay output directory containing correlation evidence. Required.

options.name: --query-store-correlation-file
options.description: Uses a correlation file outside the replay output directory.

options.name: --read-only-connection-string
options.description: Exports a schema-source DACPAC when no schema file or DACPAC is supplied.

options.name: --sqlserver-schema-file
options.description: Uses manually supplied schema SQL instead of DACPAC extraction.

options.name: --sqlserver-dacpac-file
options.description: Extracts SQL Server schema from a DACPAC.

options.name: --json-output-file
options.description: Writes advice to a specific JSON path.

options.name: --model-provider
options.description: Selects the advice provider. The supported value is openai. Required.

options.name: --openai-model
options.description: Selects the OpenAI advice model. Default: gpt-5.4-mini.

options.name: --openai-base-url
options.description: Sets the OpenAI base URL. Default: https://api.openai.com.

options.name: --openai-api-key
options.description:
Supplies the OpenAI API key used by advice generation. Required.
Notes:
- Advice derives operation-level tuning guidance from query-store-correlation.json plus SQL Server schema extracted from a DACPAC.
- Advice writes tuning-advice.json, sql-tuning-proposal.json, and sql-tuning-proposal.sql under the replay artifact directory by default.
- OpenAI advice requires --model-provider openai, --openai-api-key, and a schema source: --sqlserver-schema-file, --sqlserver-dacpac-file, or --read-only-connection-string.
- Use --debug to print per-stage diagnostics to stderr. With advise, debug prints the redacted OpenAI request and response payloads.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Prints per-stage diagnostics to stderr.

commands.name: correlate
commands.description: Correlates replay SQL with a Query Store snapshot.

options.name: --replay-artifact-dir
options.description: Replay output directory containing operation artifacts. Required.

options.name: --query-store-snapshot-file
options.description: Query Store snapshot JSON produced by observe. Required.

options.name: --read-only-connection-string
options.description: Connection string used for statement handle resolution. Required.

options.name: --json-output-file
options.description:
Writes correlation to a specific JSON path.
Notes:
- Correlation resolves statement_sql_handle against captured replay SQL, then writes query-store-correlation.json under the replay artifact directory by default.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Prints per-stage diagnostics to stderr.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffolds the sqloom agent skill in a Git repository.

options.name: --agent
options.description: Selects the agent skill location. Allowed values: codex, claude, copilot, all. Default: codex.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description:
Replaces changed scaffolded skill files.
Notes:
- Run init from a Git repository root. Sqloom writes the selected agent skill under the matching agent-specific skill directory.

commands.name: observe
commands.description: Collects SQL Server Query Store evidence and workload classification.

options.name: --read-only-connection-string
options.description: SQL Server or Azure SQL connection string used to read Query Store and metadata. Required.

options.name: --lookback-hours
options.description: Query Store lookback window in hours. Default: 24.

options.name: --max-plans
options.description: Maximum Query Store plans to capture before console filtering. Default: 100.

options.name: --max-waits
options.description: Maximum Query Store waits to capture. Default: 10.

options.name: --command-timeout-seconds
options.description: SQL command timeout for Query Store reads. Default: 30.

options.name: --json-output-file
options.description: Writes the Query Store snapshot to a specific JSON path.

options.name: --app-only
options.description: Filters the console view to App-classified entries and implies --show-classification.

options.name: --show-classification
options.description:
Prints classification details for displayed plans and waits.
Notes:
- --app-only implies classification display and filters the console view to App-classified queries when the selected harness supplies Query Store profile data.
- When a target path is supplied, Sqloom resolves it, builds harness projects unless --no-build is supplied, and requires exactly one public non-abstract ISqloomApplication implementation.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Prints per-stage diagnostics to stderr.

options.name: --dotnet-command
options.description: Uses a specific dotnet executable for project resolution and builds. Default: dotnet.

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Skips building harness projects before scanning their outputs.

commands.name: replay
commands.description: Starts the harness and replays selected OpenAPI operations.

options.name: --openapi-file
options.description: Overrides the app-owned OpenAPI document.

options.name: --sqlserver-dacpac-file
options.description: Passes a DACPAC path to harness replay launch options.

options.name: --sqlserver-seed-sql-file
options.description: Passes a SQL seed script path to harness replay launch options.

options.name: --artifact-dir
options.description: Uses a custom replay output directory. Default: artifacts/sqloom/replay/<timestamp>.

options.name: --max-operations
options.description: Caps replayed operations after filtering. Default: 25.

options.name: --target
options.description: Replays one exact operation in the form METHOD /path/template.

options.name: --replay-data-agent
options.description: Controls replay request data preparation. Allowed values: off, auto, required. Default: required.

options.name: --replay-data-agent-model
options.description: Selects the replay data agent model. Default: gpt-5.4-mini.

options.name: --openai-base-url
options.description: Sets the OpenAI base URL for the replay data agent. Default: https://api.openai.com.

options.name: --openai-api-key
options.description:
Supplies the OpenAI API key used by the replay data agent.
Notes:
- Standalone replay requires an explicit target path after the replay verb. Supported target paths are harness project files, harness assemblies, solution files, solution filters, and directories.
- Sqloom resolves that target, builds harness projects unless --no-build is supplied, and requires exactly one public non-abstract ISqloomApplication implementation.
- Pass --dotnet-command <command> when Sqloom should use a non-default dotnet executable for nested project resolution and builds.
- If a solution, solution filter, or directory resolves to zero or multiple ISqloomApplication implementations, Sqloom fails and asks for a narrower target.
- SQL Server-backed replay harnesses can consume app-owned DACPAC and seed launch options when they implement that setup.
- The replay data agent fills HTTP replay inputs only; it does not generate DACPACs or seed SQL.
- The replay data agent is replay-only. It defaults to required, uses Microsoft Agent Framework, requires --openai-api-key unless --replay-data-agent off is supplied, and writes replay-data-prep.json.
- Replay targets must use the exact form 'METHOD /path/template', for example --target "GET /api/expenses/dashboard".
- Replay defaults to authenticated GET operations plus any app overlays enabled by default. Opt-in operations such as POST /api/advisor/query require explicit --target selection.

commands.name: tune
commands.description: Runs replay, observe, correlate, and advise as one workflow.

options.name: --read-only-connection-string
options.description: Overrides the harness session connection used for Query Store and schema export.

options.name: --lookback-hours
options.description: Query Store lookback window in hours. Default: 24.

options.name: --max-plans
options.description: Maximum Query Store plans to capture before console filtering. Default: 100.

options.name: --max-waits
options.description: Maximum Query Store waits to capture. Default: 10.

options.name: --command-timeout-seconds
options.description: SQL command timeout for Query Store reads. Default: 30.

options.name: --app-only
options.description: Filters the console view to App-classified entries and implies --show-classification.

options.name: --show-classification
options.description: Prints classification details for displayed plans and waits.

options.name: --openapi-file
options.description: Overrides the app-owned OpenAPI document.

options.name: --sqlserver-dacpac-file
options.description: Overrides the DACPAC schema source used by replay launch options and advice extraction.

options.name: --sqlserver-seed-sql-file
options.description: Passes a SQL seed script path to custom harness replay launch options.

options.name: --artifact-dir
options.description: Uses a custom tune workflow root. Default: artifacts/sqloom/tune/tune-<timestamp>.

options.name: --max-operations
options.description: Caps replayed operations after filtering. Default: 25.

options.name: --target
options.description: Replays one exact operation in the form METHOD /path/template.

options.name: --replay-data-agent
options.description: Controls replay request data preparation. Allowed values: off, auto, required. Default: required.

options.name: --replay-data-agent-model
options.description: Selects the replay data agent model. Default: gpt-5.4-mini.

options.name: --model-provider
options.description: Selects the advice provider. The supported value is openai. Required.

options.name: --sqlserver-schema-file
options.description: Uses manually supplied schema SQL instead of DACPAC extraction.

options.name: --openai-model
options.description: Selects the OpenAI advice model. Default: gpt-5.4-mini.

options.name: --openai-base-url
options.description: Sets the OpenAI base URL. Default: https://api.openai.com.

options.name: --openai-api-key
options.description:
Supplies the OpenAI API key used by enabled agent workflows. Required.
Notes:
- Tune starts the harness session, runs replay -> observe -> correlate -> advise in one command, and disposes the session.
- Tune writes query-store-snapshot.json and tune-summary.json at the workflow root, then replay, correlation, and advice artifacts under the workflow replay/ directory.
- Tune uses --read-only-connection-string when supplied, otherwise it uses the harness session connection string.
- When no DACPAC override or harness manifest DACPAC is available, tune exports a DACPAC from the command-line read-only connection before replay and reuses it for advice schema extraction.
- By default, Microsoft Agent Framework fills missing replay path, query, header, and body values; pass --replay-data-agent off to opt out.
- --sqlserver-dacpac-file and --sqlserver-seed-sql-file are harness replay launch overrides; the replay data agent does not generate DACPACs or seed SQL.
- When omitted, --artifact-dir defaults to artifacts/sqloom/tune/tune-<timestamp>. With tune, --artifact-dir means the workflow root, not a replay-only directory.
